title: How is a volcano born?
note: Little Big Questions (6 to 8), a silent story (Sam 23 Oct): Fable Cutaway on the lifted-slice grammar, one fixed view, a 2 degree sway, no cuts. The slice is a young volcano island, its magma chamber glowing in the cut face; nine eruptions build nine layers. Timing from beats.json through the one event table at the top of blender.py (re-time beats.json to the chosen recording and the picture follows). Look named by KF_ART_NAME in blender.py. Music: Grieg, In the Hall of the Mountain King (Musopen Symphony, public domain), four cuts in beats.json; soundtrack in audio/mix.m4a (audio/make_audio.py, SOUND.md).
